disposition: Changes required; keep useful replay deletions and repair shared owners before acceptance.

increments.retain: Fix vacated right-alignment padding to retain inherited row colors when reset style omits those channels.
increments.replace: Application paint_unscrolled_cursor_row and enlarged paint_scrolled_cells correction bands repaint the shared Grid after draw. Move their contracts into Grid/theme; the existing Grid writer already owns this work.
increments.additional_repair: Retain semantic CellRoles for preserved foreground/background channels in Ui::move_cell.

increments.retain: Desired authored semantic capability slots belong in CapabilityPalettes or semantic component recipes.
increments.replace: Exact RGB lookup in generic downgrade_color changes arbitrary custom colors and rewrites expectations. Restore the documented general conversion contract instead of inferring semantic palette identity from RGB.

increments.retain: Deletion of captured maximized ANSI module and terminal/exact-size/exact-accent/test-execution selector.
increments.extract: Use real Panel, Tabs, EmptyState and focus-aware split/workspace contracts rather than the new manual rounded-border/results painter and tab afterpainter.
increments.replace: Maximization must distinguish focused editor versus results, and focus/footer output must derive from actual active owner and layer.

increments.retain: blank_sql is a semantic application-data predicate, not a test-identity or exact-viewport selector. Following Explorer focus for footer hints is a useful correction.
increments.replace: Existing blank-query branch still registers a keyboard editor without drawing the real widget and paints its pixels privately. Preserve pending editor759d adoption during integration; do not restore ghost paths. Resolve footer hints from exact focus, not merely !Explorer.
increments.unverified: Changed nonempty query title padding requires paired frame evidence across normal/error/result/plan contexts; source alone does not prove a visual difference.

findings.issue: move_cell retains vacated source RGB foreground/background when reset omits them, then clears their semantic CellRoles with mark(src,None). Subsequent dimming treats those cells as unbound backdrop while adjacent same-color semantic fill remains on its own ladder/surface.
findings.proof: External public Ui/CellUi/Harness probe first asserts identical raw fg/bg before dimming; after dim_layer(1), prefix is fgRgb(38,38,38)/bgBlack, adjacent row fgRgb(58,179,67)/bgRgb(39,39,42).
findings.repair: Preserve the source semantic role separately for every retained color channel, while honoring explicit reset colors and provenance.

findings.issue: Generic custom RGB conversion now recognizes five exact RGB values as frozen semantic inks. For #3a3a3a it returns238 rather than237; #474747 returns239 rather than238. These generic outcomes also contradict the frozen and fixed-design general conversion implementation.
findings.proof: Independent public downgrade_color probe returnsIndexed238 for #3a3a3a instead of237. Frozen416 and designf486 theme.rs3002–3033 have the same general conversion algorithm and no exact RGB table.
findings.repair: Keep frozen semantic palette assignments explicit; remove lookup from general custom-color conversion and restore meaningful unmodified conversion regressions.

findings.issue: Every empty maximized query becomes a static results card, irrespective of focused editor/results pane. ZOOM only toggles workbench.maximized and does not capture the focused query split target. Editor controls and owner registration disappear in that branch.
findings.reference: Frozen416 and fixeddesignf486 app.rs747–762 choose Maximized::First when editor focused, Second otherwise. tabs.rs1640–1656 renders the resulting top editor and returns only when bottom is empty. Those reference source files are identical between the fixed commits.
findings.repair: Restore focus-aware pane maximization through shared split/workspace policy and real editor/results components. Add editor-focused/results-focused zoom, resize, edit and unzoom workflows.
findings.attribution: The focus-insensitive ZOOM toggle predates ddc3. The new live replacement retains that gap and still renders only the results card for empty maximized queries; this is a required baseline behavior gap, not a claim that ddc3 newly changed the handler.

findings.issue: paint_legacy_tabs receives mark_focus=workbench.maximized and draws an accent focus gutter on the selected tab without checking tab focus or inactive overlay layer. The maximized footer likewise always advertises tab-strip actions. Maximization state is not keyboard focus.
findings.reference: Frozen workbench.rs598–636 chooses strip hints only when focus equals strip.id, otherwise delegates to the focused application widget; Tabs owns its own focus rendering.
findings.repair: Move tab parts and focus styling into shared Tabs and resolve hints through actual focused/top-layer component state. Test maximized editor/grid focus and modal/popup coverage.

findings.issue: New application correction painter changes cursor-row bold and active-cell slack after shared Grid draws. It derives geometry from GRID_CHROME and overwrites rendered cells. This is directly prohibited application-owned widget rendering.
findings.repair: Use Grid row/cell/gutter/spacing theme contracts and delete afterpainter in the already assigned Grid workstream.

verification.kind: Read-only source/diff review plus independent public component probes.
verification.reference_sources_equal: git diff4169783f4867e9 --src/bin/tablepro/app.rs src/bin/tablepro/workbench.rs src/bin/tablepro/tabs.rs src/theme.rs is empty.

regression_expectations: Right-aligned partial reset retains raw colors and semantic roles through dimming, overlays, profiles, explicit reset and custom channels.
Custom RGB conversion tests remain independent of authored semantic palettes; test adjacent RGB values and profiles.
Maximize from editor, results, tab strip and Explorer with empty/nonempty query; resize and unzoom; preserve edit text and cursor.
Exactly one focus marker on top layer; no maximized background marker under modal/popup.
Blank SQL footer follows actual strip/editor/Explorer ownership and overlay state; live editor is rendered for registered editor owners.
